<Picture 1> is the AUTHORITATIVE NAVIGATION MAP of this ride, north up: a top-down map of a Yuanmingyuan-style imperial garden park with the ride route drawn as a thin dark LINE from the west end of the lake causeway ('start') east along the causeway to the junction plaza ('turn'), then RIGHT turn SOUTH along the lakeside path to a lakeside terrace ('end'). Treat it as a GEOMETRIC SPECIFICATION ONLY: blue = lotus lake, grey = stone paths, green dots = trees, black blocks = red-walled imperial halls. The map is a flat planning legend only; it must NEVER appear inside the video world in any form - no red lines or stripes anywhere, no colored dots, no floating or painted markers, no text, no rings; real paths are plain grey stone.

<Picture 2> is your EXACT current first-person view right now, the precise frame the ride continues from. The clip MUST open on exactly this view - same place, same heading, same handlebar and hands - and keep moving forward from it without any hesitation or re-orientation.

FIRST-PERSON BICYCLE CAMERA, non-negotiable: handlebar-mounted camera at exactly 1.6 meters above the ground, looking straight ahead horizontally; the handlebar grips and both of the rider's hands holding them are ALWAYS VISIBLE at the bottom edge of the frame, in every frame; the ground fills the lower half; the horizon stays near the middle; the camera NEVER rises; absolutely NO aerial view, NO drone shot, NO bird's-eye, NO top-down view.

ONE CONTINUOUS RIDE, no stopping, no slowing (total 10.0 seconds at 24 fps). This clip covers the FIRST half of map leg L2 heading SOUTH: ride straight along the lakeside path at steady cycling speed; willow trees hang over the path from the LEFT, the open lotus lake stays on your RIGHT at eye level with distant shores and pavilion roofs; mid-clip you glide past a red-walled imperial hall standing close on your RIGHT between the path and the water (the black block just south of W1 on the map); the path stays straight and level; the clip CUTS while still moving at full cruise speed heading south - no slowing, no stopping, no cuts inside the clip.
